text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Booooo! I lost! This totally suuucks!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Big yikes... What a joke... All I can do is
laugh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What? What should I do, then? If you're
just
throwing empty words at me, I'm
gonna go off on
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I break down the reasons she lost today
and the
areas she needs to improve. If
we can address
those properly, she
should definitely be able to
win the next
race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aghh! Stop! Stop already! It doesn't
matter how
much you ramble, it's not
like I get what you're
talking about!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Basically, let's just meet up at the track
after we
get back. ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you I want you to teach me
while I'm
running. I totally get that
you're giving this a lot
of thought, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So let's start as soon as we get back to
the
academy. Don't be late!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears that Tosen Jordan has gotten
her drive
back. Afterward, we begin
training seriously.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The point of running is to win. That's
why we're
working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I can't consider myself cool unless I get
first place!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Then let's win in style next time!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying. There's no way
I'm
going out on an L note.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show everyone how much my
running
slaps! Let's gooooo!
